changeRecord.title: load moved to the wrong member or node
changeRecord.target: load 3 of case D (memberDistributed on BA2): moved to member BB2
changeRecord.whyItMatters: The total load on the structure is unchanged, so the sum of the reactions still checks -- but the load path does not: the member that should carry the load is unloaded, another carries twice its share, and the support reactions shift towards the wrong bay or storey.
changeRecord.precondition: a nodal load or member load, and another node / member to put it on
